8
An object is in equilibrium on the Earth.
Which statement is correct?
A
All the forces acting on the object are in the same direction.
B
All the forces acting on the object have the same value.
C
The object is weightless.
D
The resultant force acting on the object is zero.

options.label: A
options.text: All the forces acting on the object are in the same direction.

options.label: B
options.text: All the forces acting on the object have the same value.

options.label: D
options.text: The resultant force acting on the object is zero.
